doc: Climb, hang without input (no drain), climb down, climb up, then jump while holding back: kick off the wall, fall and land. Generated by client/src/sim/golden/generate.ts on worldgen.wasm (collision_height, water_height). Replay: start at `initial` (staminaMax in fine units), apply each frame with dt and env, compare to states[i]. Row: [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,airJumps,mode,stamina,timer,lunge,flags].
